authorityInstruction: 保留现有国情与资源差异，补建工资、学生和医疗需求、住房与警务的开局规则，校验人口、资金和容量后再采用。

damage.basis: Postwar model calibration, not observed destruction: country inventory buffer shortfall against 120 model days plus regional max(flood,storm) exposure and settlement access deficit. previousPopulation is a source revision reference, never a war-casualty history. Existing stock is retained; damaged units are temporarily uninhabitable.

accessVacancy.basis: Frictional vacancy among habitable units; not an additional household cohort or new stock.

tenure.basis: Allocate only previously unresolved aggregate ordinary stock at t0. Preserve separately established titles. HOUSEHOLDS owns the private pool; GOV owns the generated public pool. Owner occupiers, private/public renters and displaced households are mutually exclusive.

rent.basis: Per occupied rental household annual service price calibrated to the country mean annual wage. Model obligation schedule only; no claim that historical rents were observed or paid.
